hardware_dossier.transmitter: Zero-drift pulsar-disciplined USB exciter operating on 6,440.000 kHz—a restricted boundary channel between utility and broadcast allocations.
hardware_dossier.feedline_anomaly: Transmits Mon/Wed/Fri/Sun only at 0355–0415 GCT. Curiously, on Thursdays—when E08-OCTAL is off the air—an automated Syndicate noise-jammer on Ceres still fires up at 0355 GCT to jam the empty frequency.

logs.entry: ** TROJAN L4 [Perseus Rim]. 6440.000 USB, Epoch 2736.305 at 0404 GCT, unlicensed numbers station 'Three-Five-Octal' S9+10 on a no-no boundary frequency (Az 318.4°, 2,480 ly); YL synth voice reading 3-digit base-8 groups (claimed by L4 miners to be dumpling recipes). Note: yesterday (its day off), strong automated jamming still came on at 0355 GCT over an empty channel! (Operator, Asteroid 3-5-1, GOR-9)

** TROJAN L4. 6440.000 USB, Epoch 2736.301 at 0355 GCT, E08-OCTAL silent on its scheduled off-day, yet the automated Ceres Syndicate noise-jammer still fired up at 0355 sharp on bearing 272.0° to jam the empty frequency for 20 minutes! (Operator, Asteroid 3-5-1, GOR-9)

** TROJAN L4. 6440.000 USB, Epoch 2736.289 at 0400 GCT, ascending 5-note Lydian glockenspiel interval signal locked to a 641.928 Hz pulsar sub-tone; octal group [047 • 034] correlated with Euclid Prop I.34 parallelogram bisection (Operator, Asteroid 3-5-1, GOR-9)

characters.bio: The public face of E08-OCTAL on the restricted 6,440 kHz boundary channel. Because its optical tonewheel broke in 2719, the operators have to hold a live studio condenser mic up to a mechanical glockenspiel and speaker box.
characters.language_sample_transcript: Atención: Tres, Cinco, Octal. Attention: Three, Five, Octal. Group count eight. Zero-four-seven. Three-one-two. Seven-seven-one. Three-five-one. Zero-one-five. Fin de transmisión.
characters.phonetic_and_conlang_notes: Bilingual Spanish/English Base-8 (Octal 0–7) cryptographic numbers-station cadence.

characters.name: 'Old Liang' & 'Arturo' (The Open-Mic Caretakers)
characters.dialect_notes: Muffled background arguments, coughing, clanking space-heaters, and whistling tea-kettles accidentally picked up whenever they forget to mute the glockenspiel mic.

voice_profile.cadence: Grumpy domestic bickering behind the deadly-serious numbers broadcast
voice_profile.dsp_chain: High-pass room reverb + kettle whistle @ 2,150 Hz

characters.signature_quote: [Behind the cipher voice]: 'Arturo, turn off the kettle, the red mic light is on!' — 'No, eight pleats per wrapper, three-five-one grams of dough!'
characters.bio: Stationed inside Canyon Bunker #624-Hektor for twenty years with six metric tons of frozen dumpling wrappers and a code-book they use to coordinate tax-free provisions across Sector 9.
characters.language_sample_transcript: Arturo, apaga la pava, the red microphone light is on! Qué micrófono ni ocho cuartos, Old Liang! I told you, eight pleats per dumpling wrapper, three-hundred-fifty-one grams of dough!
characters.phonetic_and_conlang_notes: Bunker Caretaker Spanglish: domestic Porteño Spanish & English argument accidentally broadcast behind the octal cipher.

worldbuilding.habitat_and_culture: Hidden inside a terraced basalt canyon bunker beneath a giant curtain antenna array on Hektor. Like Russia's UVB-76 ('The Buzzer') and Cuba's HM01, the station mixes eerie cryptographic numbers with accidental live-mic comedy from the two old caretakers living inside the transmitter room.
worldbuilding.spectrum_gimmick_title: Out-of-Band Base-8 Numbers + Accidental Open Studio Mic (UVB-76 Homage)
worldbuilding.hauser_commentary: On the no-no boundary frequency of 6440 USB, 'Three-Five-Octal' was sending its usual base-eight groups—until 0404 GCT, when the studio mic picked up someone kicking a metal space-heater, a tea-kettle whistling, and a muffled voice muttering 'no, eight pleats per wrapper.'
worldbuilding.qsl_postcard_style: Stark Cryptic Trefoil Emblem & Buff Cardstock Card (inspired by Red Mercury Labs & 4VEH Haiti)
worldbuilding.qsl_animation_notes: The 3-5-1 trefoil blades flash while octal groups typewrite across the center; on Frame 5 an open-mic whistling tea-kettle pops up before a red 'STAMPED: KEY 015' rubber stamp slams over it.

discovery_arc.summary: Decoded octal manifest for 6.0 metric tons of pork-chive dumpling wrappers + octal shift key 015 (decimal 13).
At 0404 GCT, Old Liang drops the mechanical glockenspiel mallet; for 45 seconds listeners hear a whistling kettle and an argument about Quarantine Buoy 12.

flow_plates.caption: Brutalist concrete-and-steel terraced mining canyon on Shard #624-Hektor, crowned by the high-power shortwave curtain antenna array on the canyon rim.
